description: Decode a pasted bounce: a full NDR email, an SMTP error line or a mail-log fragment. Finds the SMTP reply code and the enhanced status code (RFC 3463 X.Y.Z), names the provider that sent it (Google, Microsoft, Yahoo, Apple, Comcast, Proofpoint, Mimecast, Barracuda), and returns what the code means and how to fix it. `verdict` is permanent (5xx, finding BOUNCE_PERMANENT, status fail), temporary (4xx, BOUNCE_TEMPORARY, warn), delivered (2xx, pass) or no_code (BOUNCE_NO_CODE, info). When the bounce has no enhanced code, a known phrase in the wording picks the explanation and BOUNCE_CODE_INFERRED says so; analysis.enhanced_code stays null. BOUNCE_AUTH_RELATED marks codes receivers return for SPF, DKIM or DMARC failures: follow up with check_spf, check_dkim and check_dmarc on the sending domain. `analysis.entry` carries the meaning, causes, remediation[] and a link to the code's page, or is null for a code the database does not cover. The echoed `input` is the byte count only. Read-only.

bounce.description: The bounce as one string: a full NDR email, a single SMTP error line (e.g. "550 5.1.1 User unknown") or a mail-log fragment.
